title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Cape Town, 20–22 November, 2015–2025
claims: For Cape Town on 20–22 November in 2015–2025 there are 33 daily records: daily maximum 16.5–30.2 °C (median 23.6 °C), daily minimum 9.8–17.4 °C (median 14.8 °C), 10 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 5 days with at least 5 mm.
The station is a city grid point, not a measurement on Table Mountain, Lion's Head or the Hout Bay coast.

verification.note: Daily values retrieved and filtered to 20–22 November; medians and wet-day counts calculated locally.

claimVerification.note: API coordinates -33.97, 18.60; Cape Town city station.
